rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s interagency information procedure. Both allocate responsibilities among designated agencies, require consultation with agencies possessing relevant information or related responsibilities, and expressly address information restricted for military-security reasons. Those combined parallels are more concrete than a shared administrative topic. C18 also contains substantial interagency collection, analysis, submission, and confidentiality machinery, but its elaborate trade-agreement process is less closely aligned. C17 has the basic designation-and-assistance structure but is too brief and routine to be the strongest source.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Director's determination ... shall be made after consulting appropriate Federal executive agencies and giving due consideration to any responsibility now exercised by any of them
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Each governmental officer or agency exercising authority delegated under this order shall ... consult with other agencies or committees having special information or sources of such information ... and with other agencies or committees having responsibilities related to such authority.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively parallel consultation machinery links the decisionmaker to agencies possessing relevant information and agencies with existing related responsibilities.

shared_material.child_excerpt: information during any period of time when the agency having primary responsibility for security of the specified information declares that it must be withheld ... in the interest of military security
shared_material.parent_excerpt: showing which information, if any, is subject to restrictions for reasons of military security
shared_material.explanation: Both directives specifically incorporate military-security restrictions into an interagency information process.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall determine which Federal executive agency or agencies shall prepare the statistical information ... [which] shall be transmitted ... through established channels
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Each agency shall establish such committees and other working groups as may be appropriate to consult with and obtain the advice of other agencies.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish coordinated administrative machinery for obtaining and processing information across multiple agencies, though the child adapts it to statistical responses for intergovernmental organizations.
